name: LS Adguard Home Sync
description: 🛡️ Synchronize AdGuard Home config to replicas. This is the LinuxServer version.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Origin password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-adguard-home-sync application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-ls-adguard-home-sync
  # The `big-bear-ls-adguard-home-sync` service definition
  big-bear-ls-adguard-home-sync:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-ls-adguard-home-sync
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: linuxserver/adguardhome-sync:0.9.5@sha256:b5408234cc8073cc0a7e38762eecb5c3a0f7c8aae8bf0db4adac36ef99258a07
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
      - ORIGIN_URL=https://192.168.1.2:3000
      - ORIGIN_USERNAME=bigbear
      - ORIGIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET_ORIGIN_PASSWORD}
      - REPLICA_URL=https://192.168.1.3:3000
      - REPLICA_USERNAME=bigbear
      - REPLICA_PASSWORD=${SECRET_ORIGIN_PASSWORD}
      - CRON="0 */2 * * *"
      - RUN_ON_START=true
      - API_PORT=8080
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local adguard-home-sync/config directory to /config inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 8080 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
